plugin.name: Miragon BPMN Modeler
plugin.description:
Model BPMN 2.0 process diagrams visually, right inside your JetBrains IDE — no need to switch to a separate modeling tool.

Open any .bpmn file on a drag-and-drop canvas and edit it like a diagram; your changes are saved straight back to the file, ready to commit alongside your code.

Highlights

  • Draw and edit BPMN 2.0 diagrams on a visual canvas, with a source view for when you need it.
  • Compare two versions of a diagram side by side in your IDE's diff and version-control views.
  • Write task scripts with context-aware suggestions.
  • Deploy diagrams to a running Camunda 7 or Camunda 8 engine without leaving the IDE.

Troubleshooting

If a diagram fails to open or an action misbehaves, the plugin surfaces errors as IDE notifications and records the full detail in the IDE log. Open it via Help | Show Log in Finder / Explorer (or bundle it with Help | Collect Logs and Diagnostic Data).

When filing a bug, capture more detail first: open Help | Diagnostic Tools | Debug Log Settings…, add io.miragon, reproduce the problem, then attach the log. Deployment passwords and client secrets are stored in the IDE's password safe and are redacted from the log, so it is safe to attach.

For the complete feature list and documentation, visit miragon.github.io/bpmn-modeler.

Source & issues: github.com/Miragon/bpmn-modeler
